source: ext/sprunki-website/assets/project.json (decompiled TurboWarp/Scratch project); rebuilt via scripts/dev/build-sprunki-manifest.py
fileNamingNote: All file values are content-addressed by md5; resolve as `${assetRoot}${file}`. svgs are vector character/UI art, wavs are 48 kHz stems.

categories.drums: Rhythm-section stems (kick, snare, cymbal, break, shaker).
categories.melody: Tonal stems (piano, organ, music-box, brass, arpeggio, square synth).
categories.vocal: Sung / spoken stems (hey lead, AI singing, choirs).
categories.fx: Non-pitched effect stems (whistle, vocal glitch, buildup riser).

costumeBuckets.idle: Safe resting frame (default mode). One entry per character.
costumeBuckets.idle_alternate: Horror-mode resting frame (project.json `idle2`). Only surfaced when scary mode is unlocked + enabled.
costumeBuckets.alternate: Horror-mode play cycle (project.json `anim???`, `anim???2`, ...). Hidden unless scary mode is on.
costumeBuckets.other: Costumes that don't match the idle / anim / anim??? naming (overlays, UI fragments).

soundBuckets.primary: Default loop fired when the character is placed.
soundBuckets.alternate: Phase-2 / 'evil' variant. Each character has 0–2 alternates; some (e.g. Yellow, Blue) have multiple alternate generations because the audio was re-cut.
